comments.author: GrayBeard
comments.body:
To sail it or build it?
Sailing is 12-6-26

To build any ship add the levels to sail subtract 14, divide by 4 and add 1 and round ALL remainders up

So for this ship 12+6+26 = 44, 44-14 = 30, 30/4 = 7.5, 7.5+1 = 8.5
Or level 9 ship building required to build this ship. That formula works with any ship

comments.author: GrayBeard
comments.body:
They are sort of slow, and do not turn well. If you use one I recommend using a special shipbuilding permit or two on them

Do two improvements.
First: Latin Sail + Special Light Oars + High Quality Rigging
Second: Square Sail + Painter Rope + High Quality Rigging

That will make the ship a LOT faster and really improve the turn mode
